review.exabeam.exabeam.is.a.next-generat: Exabeam is a next-generation SIEM (Security Information and Event Management) platform that revolutionizes security operations through behavioral analytics and AI-powered automation. Unlike traditional SIEMs that overwhelm teams with alerts, Exabeam uses machine learning to understand normal user behavior and automatically surfaces genuine threats.
review.exabeam.the.platforms.smart.timel: The platform's Smart Timelines feature automatically stitches together user activities from thousands of log sources into comprehensive attack narratives, dramatically reducing investigation time from hours to minutes. Exabeam's behavioral models continuously learn what's normal for each user, entity, and asset—detecting anomalies that indicate compromised accounts, insider threats, and sophisticated attacks.
review.exabeam.with.cloud-native.archite: With cloud-native architecture and unlimited data ingestion in higher tiers, Exabeam eliminates the data volume constraints that plague legacy SIEMs, enabling organizations to collect security telemetry without worrying about licensing costs.
review.exabeam.auto-generated.attack.nar: Auto-generated attack narratives that correlate user activities across all data sources into visual timelines.
User and Entity Behavior Analytics with ML models that baseline normal behavior and detect anomalies.
Modern architecture with unlimited data ingestion, eliminating volume-based pricing constraints.
review.exabeam.ai-driven.triage.and.inve: AI-driven triage and investigation automation that prioritizes real threats and reduces false positives.
review.exabeam.pre-built.use.cases.cover: Pre-built use cases covering MITRE ATT&CK framework with continuous detection updates.

review.exabeam.smart.timelines.automatic: Smart Timelines automatically stitch together all activities for a user, asset, or entity from thousands of log sources into chronological visual narratives. This transforms investigation from searching through logs to reviewing complete attack stories, reducing MTTI from hours to minutes.
review.exabeam.exabeam.builds.behavioral: Exabeam builds behavioral baselines for every user and entity using machine learning. It learns what's normal—typical login times, locations, applications accessed, data volumes—and assigns risk scores to anomalous activities. Multiple anomalies trigger high-priority alerts indicating potential compromise.
review.exabeam.yes.with.fusion.and.fusio: Yes, with Fusion and Fusion XDR tiers. This eliminates the data volume pricing model of traditional SIEMs, allowing you to ingest logs from all sources without worrying about licensing costs scaling with data volume.
review.exabeam.yes.many.organizations.mi: Yes. Many organizations migrate from Splunk and IBM QRadar to Exabeam for modern cloud architecture, unlimited data ingestion, and superior UEBA. Migration services and dual-deployment support available during transition.
review.exabeam.initial.behavioral.models: Initial behavioral models start providing value within 2-4 weeks. Full baseline accuracy improves over 90 days as the system learns patterns. Pre-built threat detection rules work immediately while behavioral analytics mature.
review.exabeam.exabeam.represents.the.fu: Exabeam represents the future of SIEM with its behavioral analytics, unlimited data ingestion, and Smart Timelines automation. The platform dramatically reduces investigation time and false positives while detecting sophisticated threats that evade rule-based systems. Ideal for enterprises seeking modern, cloud-native SIEM that scales without traditional licensing constraints.
